name: Ryoujoku Santa
source:
It is said that the Gods and angels do miracles on Christmas day. But good things and bad things existing in this world should be equal, otherwise it will lose its balance and might destroy the world. So the main character thinks it would be better if there is more unhappiness in this world. And the worst Santa Claus is born...
